cat > probe.py <<'EOF_PROBE'
# MC43 asset probe: download candidate Blendkit assets, record structure, render a lineup contact sheet.
# Run: Blender -b -P probe.py -- picks.json out_dir
import bpy, math, os, sys, json, uuid, time, urllib.request, urllib.parse
import numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector

argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--") + 1:]
PICKS = json.load(open(argv[0]))
OUTD = os.path.abspath(argv[1]); os.makedirs(OUTD, exist_ok=True)
HOME = os.environ.get("AGENT_HOME", os.path.expanduser("~/ShortsRenderAgent"))
ADIR = os.path.join(HOME, "assets"); os.makedirs(ADIR, exist_ok=True)
UA = {"User-Agent": "blenderkit/3.21.3 (Blender 5.2.3)", "accept": "application/json"}

def get_key():
    for name, ad in bpy.context.preferences.addons.items():
        if "blenderkit" in name.lower():
            return getattr(ad.preferences, "api_key", "") or ""
    return ""
KEY = get_key()

def fetch(url, path, timeout=600):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": UA["User-Agent"]})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r, open(path + ".part", "wb") as f:
        while True:
            b = r.read(1 << 20)
            if not b: break
            f.write(b)
    os.replace(path + ".part", path)

def bk_file(aid, durl):
    p = os.path.join(ADIR, "bk_" + aid + ".blend")
    if os.path.exists(p) and os.path.getsize(p) > 1000: return p, "cached"
    errs = []
    for host_url in [durl, durl.replace("www.blenderkit.com", "api.blenderkit.com")]:
        try:
            h = dict(UA); h["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + KEY
            q = host_url + "?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"scene_uuid": str(uuid.uuid4())})
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(q, headers=h), timeout=60)
            fp = json.loads(r.read().decode())["filePath"]
            fetch(fp, p)
            return p, "ok"
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append(type(e).__name__ + ":" + str(getattr(e, "code", ""))[:6])
    return None, "/".join(errs)

sc = bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine = "BLENDER_EEVEE"
try: sc.eevee.taa_render_samples = 8
except Exception: pass
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y = 360, 540
sc.render.resolution_percentage = 100
sc.render.image_settings.file_format = "PNG"
w = bpy.data.worlds.new("W"); sc.world = w; w.use_nodes = True
bg = w.node_tree.nodes.get("Background"); bg.inputs["Color"].default_value = (0.35, 0.37, 0.4, 1); bg.inputs["Strength"].default_value = 1.0
try: sc.view_settings.view_transform = "AgX"
except Exception: pass

INFO = {}
thumbs = []
T0 = time.time()
for key, (aid, durl) in PICKS.items():
    t1 = time.time()
    rec = {"id": aid}
    for o in list(bpy.data.objects): bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)
    p, st = bk_file(aid, durl)
    rec["dl"] = st
    if not p:
        INFO[key] = rec; continue
    rec["mb"] = round(os.path.getsize(p) / 1e6, 1)
    try:
        with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):
            dt.objects = list(df.objects)
        objs = [o for o in dt.objects if o is not None]
        for o in objs:
            if o.type in ("CAMERA", "LIGHT"): continue
            sc.collection.objects.link(o)
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
        mn = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9)); mx = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
        obl = []
        for o in sc.objects:
            ent = {"n": o.name, "t": o.type, "par": o.parent.name if o.parent else None, "hide": bool(o.hide_render)}
            if o.type == "MESH":
                ent["v"] = len(o.data.vertices); ent["m"] = [m.name for m in o.data.materials if m][:6]
                ent["mods"] = [m.type for m in o.modifiers][:5]
                if not o.hide_render:
                    for c in o.bound_box:
                        wv = o.matrix_world @ Vector(c)
                        mn = Vector((min(mn.x, wv.x), min(mn.y, wv.y), min(mn.z, wv.z)))
                        mx = Vector((max(mx.x, wv.x), max(mx.y, wv.y), max(mx.z, wv.z)))
                ent["bb"] = [round(x, 3) for x in (o.matrix_world.translation)]
            if o.type == "ARMATURE":
                ent["bones"] = [b.name for b in o.data.bones]
                ent["nb"] = len(o.data.bones)
                # rest head positions (world) of key-looking bones
                ent["heads"] = {b.name: [round(x, 3) for x in (o.matrix_world @ b.head_local)] for b in o.data.bones if any(k in b.name.lower() for k in ("hips", "pelvis", "spine", "head", "neck", "upperarm", "upper_arm", "forearm", "hand", "thigh", "upleg", "leg", "shin", "foot", "shoulder", "arm", "root"))}
                ent["heads"] = dict(list(ent["heads"].items())[:70])
            obl.append(ent)
        rec["objs"] = obl[:120]
        rec["nobj"] = len(obl)
        rec["bbox"] = [[round(x, 3) for x in mn], [round(x, 3) for x in mx]]
        # thumbnail
        if mn.x < 1e8:
            c = (mn + mx) / 2; d = mx - mn; r = max(d.length / 2, 0.01)
            cd = bpy.data.cameras.new("c"); cd.lens = 50; cd.sensor_fit = "VERTICAL"; cd.sensor_height = 24
            cam = bpy.data.objects.new("c", cd); sc.collection.objects.link(cam); sc.camera = cam
            dist = r / math.tan(math.atan(12 / 50)) * 1.15
            dirv = Vector((0.55, -1.0, 0.35)).normalized()
            cam.location = c + dirv * dist
            cam.rotation_euler = (c - cam.location).to_track_quat("-Z", "Y").to_euler()
            cd.clip_start = dist / 1000; cd.clip_end = dist * 10
            ld = bpy.data.lights.new("s", "SUN"); ld.energy = 3.5; lo = bpy.data.objects.new("s", ld); sc.collection.objects.link(lo)
            lo.rotation_euler = (math.radians(50), 0, math.radians(30))
            fn = os.path.join(OUTD, "th_%s.png" % key)
            sc.render.filepath = fn
            bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
            thumbs.append((key, fn))
    except Exception as e:
        rec["err"] = type(e).__name__ + " " + str(e)[:120]
    rec["sec"] = round(time.time() - t1, 1)
    INFO[key] = rec
    json.dump(INFO, open(os.path.join(OUTD, "info.json"), "w"))
    for b in [bpy.data.meshes, bpy.data.materials, bpy.data.images, bpy.data.armatures, bpy.data.actions]:
        for x in list(b):
            if x.users == 0:
                try: b.remove(x)
                except Exception: pass

# contact sheet with labels drawn as simple blocks is not possible without fonts; label order = info.json key order
cols = 6; tw, th = 360, 540
rows = max(1, math.ceil(len(thumbs) / cols))
sheet = np.zeros((rows * th, cols * tw, 4), dtype=np.float32); sheet[..., 3] = 1
for i, (k, fn) in enumerate(thumbs):
    im = bpy.data.images.load(fn)
    a = np.empty(im.size[0] * im.size[1] * 4, dtype=np.float32); im.pixels.foreach_get(a)
    a = a.reshape(im.size[1], im.size[0], 4)
    r, cidx = i // cols, i % cols
    y0 = (rows - 1 - r) * th
    sheet[y0:y0 + th, cidx * tw:cidx * tw + tw] = a[:th, :tw]
out = bpy.data.images.new("sheet", cols * tw, rows * th, alpha=False)
out.pixels.foreach_set(sheet.ravel())
out.filepath_raw = os.path.join(OUTD, "sheet.png"); out.file_format = "PNG"; out.save()
INFO["_order"] = [k for k, _ in thumbs]
INFO["_sec"] = round(time.time() - T0, 1)
json.dump(INFO, open(os.path.join(OUTD, "info.json"), "w"))
print("probe done", time.time() - T0)

EOF_PROBE

rm -rf pr && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P probe.py -- picks.json $PWD/pr > probe.log 2>&1; mkdir -p pr; ls -la pr | head -40; [ -f pr/info.json ] || (grep -v -i -e bearer -e api_key -e authorization probe.log | tail -60 | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.dumps({"log": sys.stdin.read()}))' > pr/info.json); [ -f pr/sheet.png ] || cp $(ls pr/th_*.png | head -1) pr/sheet.png 2>/dev/null; true
